meta.title: CPZ — CardputerZero OS
meta.desc: CPZ is a console-first Raspberry Pi OS for CardputerZero: boots straight into a terminal and tmux, runs with minimal memory, installs from a ready-to-flash release image and is driven entirely from the keyboard.
hero.lead: A console-first Linux for the CardputerZero handheld. It boots straight into a fast terminal with a persistent tmux session — no desktop, compositor or background services.
hero.note: Minimal memory footprint. Simple to install from a release image. Simple to use from the keyboard.
philosophy.title: Philosophy
philosophy.intro: CPZ is built around a small set of rules. They decide what goes into the image, what a key does, and what the system refuses to do in the background.
p1.d: There is no desktop, compositor, launcher or first-boot wizard. kmscon draws the console on tty1, tmux organizes the work, and every other tool is a command.
p2.d: No desktop environment, no search index and no maintenance daemons. Everything that is not in use is not running, so RAM and CPU stay free for the work at hand.
p3.d: Download the latest release image, write it to a microSD card with Raspberry Pi Imager, balenaEtcher or dd, insert it and boot. No manual package setup is required.
p4.d: The keyboard drives everything. Alt shortcuts open tabs, panes, search and Settings, and the Settings TUI manages Wi-Fi, display, sound, power and applications without config files.
p5.d: tmux runs detached. Theme, font and output changes may restart kmscon while tabs, pane directories and running programs stay alive.
install.title: Install
install.intro: CPZ ships as a ready-to-flash Raspberry Pi OS image. Every release includes the image, its checksums and metadata.
install.s1: Download the latest image from the Releases page.
install.s2: Write it to a microSD card with Raspberry Pi Imager, balenaEtcher or dd.
install.s3: Insert the card and power on. CPZ boots straight into the console with no setup wizard.
install.note: Images are built from a published GitHub release and verified before upload.
keys.title: Key reference
keys.intro: Every binding below works directly: press Alt with the listed key. No tmux prefix is needed. On the internal keyboard, plus and minus are Sym+T and Sym+R.
k.session.font: Larger / smaller font, saved in Settings
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Alt+S opens a full-screen TUI. It is always the last tab and cannot be closed; the shell is always the first. Values are stored per user and reapplied at boot.
settings.network: Wi-Fi (NetworkManager TUI), Ethernet status, VPN profiles, addresses
settings.display: Theme, brightness, screen timeout, output mode, font size, status bar
settings.sound: Output and input volume, mute and device selection (PipeWire)
settings.keyboard: Layout mode, enabled layouts, active layout, key reference
settings.datetime: Date, time, time zone, automatic NTP
settings.power: Battery status, reboot, shut down, suspend
settings.apps: Terminal Trove catalog; install and remove apt packages
settings.system: About, resources, security (password, SSH), terminal options, reset
footer.based: Based on Raspberry Pi OS and pi-gen. Terminal session: kmscon + tmux.
